title: Languages that compile to SQL
summary: A short, MIT-licensed list of query languages that compile to SQL, grouped as strongly typed (Ermine), alternate query syntax (GraphQL via Hasura, LINQ, Malloy, PRQL) and logic programming (Datalog, Yedalog, Logica, Constraint Handling Rules), plus a few alternatives that don’t compile to SQL, such as EdgeDB and Morel. A quick map of the landscape with one line and a link per entry; it is small and some descriptions are dated.
